data.narrative:
Intramotev is a Series A drone and autonomous systems company that has raised $14.4M to date. The broader Drones & Autonomous sector comprises 8 private peers (including Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, Archer Aviation, and Elroy Air) with no public comparables available. A narrow peer-median approach proved inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage datapoints meeting minimum thresholds within the same valuation tier.

Stage-progression analysis, grounded in the $14.4M total raised as a valuation proxy, applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A-to-next-stage advancement, yielding an implied valuation of $29M. This method is the primary quantitative anchor given the limited peer data available.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $24M to $33M, with a median of $29M. Key uncertainties include the absence of a sufficiently deep peer cohort for cross-validation and reliance on a single methodological pillar. A stage-progression framework assumes typical market conditions and comparable dilution patterns; material deviations in this company's burn rate, market traction, or investor appetite could shift outcomes materially within or beyond the stated range. Additional datapoints on near-term funding activity or comparable round economics would strengthen confidence in any specific point within this band.
